review.reviewBody: The peace of mind of being able to call or send a message from the other side of the world, and receiving an almost instant reply. It’s the feeling of never being alone.
They suggest things you don't even think of.
We feel like we hit the jackpot when we chose Honeymooners.
If you truly don’t want to worry about a thing, Honeymooners is the right travel agency for that.
We chose Honeymooners because of their personalized and human touch.
We arrived at our accommodation and realized it was exactly what we needed.
They want the trip to go just as well as we do...
We said what we wanted and even what we didn’t want, and they delivered.
I found in Honeymooners the essentials for me to be able to make this marriage proposal.
Honeymooners is synonymous with happiness, because it reminds me of all the wonderful trips we’ve taken together.

about.name: Dubai, France, Maldives, Mauritius, New York & Qatar

review.reviewBody: We shouldn’t put our dreams away in drawers. We should go, we never know what tomorrow may bring… living is now.
We were focused on creating memories together, and it was without a doubt a highlight of our lives.
We truly felt that the trip was designed for us.
We envisioned our dream and Honeymooners made it come true.
When we received the proposal from Honeymooners, we were like ‘wow’, and that’s when we realized it was exactly what we were looking for.
They managed to surprise us with their trust, their sense of security, and by always being there for us, 24 hours a day.
What made us choose Honeymooners is that they actually visit the countries and hotels. They don’t just recommend places for the sake of it.
Incredible experiences that we never imagined having on that trip.
It's a very personalized touch; they don't just listen to what we like, they take what we convey and create a profile of the person.
The process was very simple… to convey exactly what we wanted and then just enjoy it.
From the very first moment, they always said they would achieve what I had envisioned… and they delivered even more.
Knowing that, if we need anything, there is always someone available 24/7.
It was a beautiful moment, something I would never have been able to create on my own.
Having someone from the team supporting us at every step of the journey made the experience itself so much smoother.
They were always attentive, always responded as quickly as possible, always found solutions.
The best thing we did was reach out to Honeymooners.
It was what we wanted without knowing it.
Even before getting married, we already knew our honeymoon would be with Honeymooners.
Sometimes we still can't believe it actually happened.
It’s the trip we’ll never forget. We saw it all at Honeymooners.
Very few people get to experience something like this, so it's really that feeling of fulfillment.
I hope this wasn’t the last trip with Honeymooners and that there are even more trips ahead.
